title: Commando
developer: Chris Butler, Rory Green, Chris Harvey
build: REMEMBER Commando 100% +5 crack/high-score-saver release in the contributor-supplied D64; retail provenance unverified.

tools.emulator: VICE release v3.13.2, v3.13.2-linux-x86_64-gui.zip; PAL C64SC

extra: battlefield charset: first and second 128-glyph bitmap banks
HUD charset: glyphs 0–127 in RAM beneath VIC-II I/O
HUD charset: glyphs 128–255 in RAM beneath SID/CIA I/O
Sprite-bit masks: eight one-hot masks and their eight complements used for X-MSB and priority assembly
Thirteen eight-byte SID instrument parameter records; pulse width, control, ADSR and modulation fields are selected by the channel updater
Sixteen sixteen-byte SID sound-effect presets; $5531 selects a record using the low nibble of $5527
Three six-byte voice-stream pointer descriptors: three low bytes followed by three high bytes, copied by $5F0C
Low bytes for 45 sequence-data pointers, indexed by the sequence-command parser at $50AA
High bytes paired by index with the low-byte sequence-pointer table at $5711
64-byte initialization source read by $3575 and copied into the per-slot field at $0432,X; the field meaning is not yet identified
Ninety-six little-endian SID note periods, indexed by note number in the music and effect routines
include: RAM under I/O used as VIC character data
